name: Multi-agent review: run from the PR picker, retry a failed column, configure a run, learn a finding
description: SPEC-03 (Multi-Agent Review). From PR #482, open the Run Review picker, start a multi-agent run and land on the results page (AC-4: URL contains /multi-agent/ and the header meta line '<N> agents · parallel · …' renders). The run's columns fail without a reload and each failed column shows 'Retry' (AC-51). Then 'Configure run' (the PR is preselected via ?pr=) -> Run lands on a second results page (AC-17). Finally PR #482's Agent runs tab: 'Learn' on a seeded finding flips to 'Learned' (AC-74). DETERMINISM (plan R1): this flow starts REAL runs. It is deterministic ONLY when no provider key is configured (the CI condition in .github/workflows/e2e-web.yml, and a hermetic ./scripts/e2e.sh stack on a machine with no keys in ~/.devdigest/secrets.json or the environment): every run then fails at provider resolution before any model call, so the 'Retry' button appears. On a dev stack WITH keys the runs make paid model calls and reach 'done' (no 'Retry'), so step 'AC-51' times out. Do not run it against a keyed stack. The step after the first run uses a tall viewport (nested <main> scroll container, see e2e/INSIGHTS.md). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB with migration 0018 applied (see e2e/README.md).
